items.prompt: At n=2000, how many unordered pairs can the direct worst-case scan examine?

options.why: That is one per agent rather than every distinct pair.
n^2 counts self-pairs and both orientations.
n(n-1)/2=2000*1999/2; this supports the stated O(n^2) design at its bounded size.
Halving n does not count all pair combinations.
